newly made, not old
having a good taste
have a smell

vocabulary.meaning_en: a list of food and drinks in a restaurant
a light tea made from green leaves
vocabulary.example: I would like a green tea, please.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sweet fizzy drink
vocabulary.example: We have tea, coffee, and soda.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very tasty (informal)

vocabulary.example: I can't decide what to order.

a burger made without meat, from vegetables or beans
vocabulary.note_en: "Veggie" is short for vegetable or vegetarian.
vocabulary.example: I will try the veggie burger.

vocabulary.meaning_en: Italian food made from flour and water, like spaghetti
a seed of a plant that we cook and eat
vocabulary.example: The patty is made of beans.

vocabulary.meaning_en: give part of something to another person
try food to know its flavour

fine_lines.title: look vs smell vs taste
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نستخدم هذه الأفعال مع صفة: It looks nice (شكله)، It smells good (رائحته)، It tastes great (طعمه).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use these verbs + adjective: looks (how it seems to the eyes), smells (to the nose), tastes (to the mouth).

expressions.phrase: I am excited to try this new restaurant!
expressions.meaning_ar: أنا متحمس لتجربة هذا المطعم الجديد!
expressions.meaning_en: You are happy to try a new place.
expressions.example: I am excited to try this new café!

expressions.phrase: I'll be taking care of you today.
expressions.meaning_en: The waiter introduces himself or herself.
expressions.example: Hello! I'm Sam and I'll be taking care of you today.

expressions.phrase: Can I start you off with some drinks?
expressions.meaning_en: The waiter asks about drinks first.
expressions.example: Can I start you off with some water?

expressions.phrase: Here is the menu for you to look at.
expressions.example: Here is the menu. Take your time.

expressions.phrase: I can't decide what to order.
expressions.meaning_ar: لا أستطيع أن أقرر ماذا أطلب.
expressions.meaning_en: You don't know what to choose.
expressions.example: Everything looks good. I can't decide!

expressions.meaning_en: The waiter asks if you have chosen.
expressions.example: Are you ready to order? Yes, we are.

expressions.meaning_en: Asking the waiter for a good dish.
expressions.example: This is our first time here. What do you recommend?

expressions.phrase: What is in the veggie burger?

expressions.meaning_en: The food will come very soon.

expressions.phrase: I can't wait to taste the food!
expressions.example: I can't wait to try it!

grammar.title: will for decisions
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم will عندما نقرر الآن أثناء الكلام: I will have the pasta. I will try the veggie burger.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "will" for decisions you make at the moment of speaking.
examples: I will have a coffee with milk.
I will try the veggie burger.

grammar.title: I would like / I will have
grammar.explanation_ar: للطلب في المطعم: I would like + الشيء، أو I will have + the + الشيء.
grammar.explanation_en: To order: "I would like ..." or "I will have ...".
examples: I would like a green tea, please.

questions.question: "What do you recommend?" means ...
choices: What do you want to eat?
Which dish do you think is good?
questions.explanation_en: "Recommend" means say something is good to try.

questions.question: What is lettuce?
questions.explanation_en: Lettuce is a green leaf vegetable.

questions.question: A veggie burger has no ...
questions.explanation_en: A veggie burger has no meat.

questions.question: "One veggie burger coming right up." The food will come ...
It ____ really good here. (about the nose)
Choose the correct sentence:
choices: I will to have the pasta.

questions.question: "Are you ready to order?" "____"
choices: Yes. I'd like the soup, please.
questions.explanation_en: The customer answers with an order.

questions.question: "We can share the pasta." "Share" means ...
choices: each person eats part of it
questions.explanation_en: "Share" means each person has part of it.

questions.question: "Can I start you off with some drinks?" Who says this?
questions.explanation_en: The waiter asks about drinks first.
